fact_text: The minimum EP qualifying salary for candidates aged 23 or below (all sectors except financial services) is SGD 5,600 per month, increasing progressively with age up to SGD 10,700 at age 45 and above.
evidence_quote: $5,600 (increases progressively with age from age 23, up to $10,700 at age 45 and above)

fact_text: The Employment Pass allows foreign professionals, managers, executives and technicians to work in Singapore, with a minimum salary of SGD 5,600 per month.
evidence_quote: The Employment Pass allows foreign professionals, managers, executives and technicians to work in Singapore. Candidates need to earn at least $5,600 a month.

fact_text: An EP application must earn at least 40 points to pass COMPASS.
evidence_quote: Your application needs to earn 40 points to pass COMPASS.

fact_text: COMPASS (Complementarity Assessment Framework) is a transparent points-based system that enables employers to select high-quality foreign professionals while improving workforce diversity and building a strong local core.
evidence_quote: COMPASS is a transparent points-based system that gives businesses greater clarity and certainty for manpower planning. It enables employers to select high-quality foreign professionals, while improving workforce diversity and building a strong local core.

fact_text: Candidates earning a fixed monthly salary of at least SGD 22,500 are exempt from the COMPASS assessment.
evidence_quote: Have a fixed monthly salary of at least $22,500

fact_text: The Employment Pass application is submitted online by the employer or appointed employment agent via the EP eService.
evidence_quote: You can apply for an Employment Pass online as an employer or appointed employment agent.

fact_text: The EP application fee is SGD 105, payable by GIRO, Visa, Mastercard or Amex.
evidence_quote: Pay the $105 fee by GIRO, Visa, Mastercard or Amex.

fact_text: Upon approval, the EP issuance fee is SGD 225 per pass, with an additional SGD 30 for a Multiple Journey Visa if applicable.
evidence_quote: Pay the fees using GIRO, Visa, Mastercard or Amex: $225 for each pass (If applicable) $30 for each Multiple Journey Visa

fact_text: Online EP applications are processed or given an update within 10 business days.
evidence_quote: If you apply online: Processed or given an update within 10 business days.

fact_text: Short-term travellers holding a passport from a visa-required country must apply for a visa to enter Singapore.
evidence_quote: Short-Term travellers holding a passport or travel document from a visa-required country/region must apply for a Visa

fact_text: Employers are required to pay CPF contributions only for employees who are Singapore Citizens or Singapore Permanent Residents earning more than SGD 50 per month — EP holders as foreign nationals are not covered.
evidence_quote: As an employer, you're required to pay CPF contributions for your employees who are Singapore Citizens or Singapore Permanent Residents and who are earning total wages of more than $50 per month.

fact_text: The CPF contribution rate depends on whether the employee is a Singapore Citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident, their age, and total wages.
evidence_quote: The CPF contribution rate applicable depends on whether employee is a Singapore Citizen or Singapore Permanent Resident, age, and total wages.

fact_text: To bring family members on a Dependant's Pass, the EP holder must earn a minimum fixed monthly salary of SGD 6,000.
evidence_quote: Earn a minimum fixed monthly salary of $6,000. This is based on your salary, and not based on your combined household income.

fact_text: Dependant's Pass holders who wish to work in Singapore must obtain a separate work pass — either an Employment Pass, S Pass, or DP Work Permit — through a prospective employer.
evidence_quote: Prospective employers can apply for an Employment Pass (EP), S Pass, or DP-Work Permit (DP-WP) for their DP holders.

fact_text: An EP holder can apply for a Long-Term Visit Pass for their parents only if they earn a fixed monthly salary of at least SGD 12,000.
evidence_quote: Parents – only for those earning a fixed monthly salary of at least $12,000.

fact_text: To be eligible to apply for a Long-Term Visit Pass for family members, the EP holder must earn a minimum fixed monthly salary of SGD 6,000.
evidence_quote: Earn a minimum fixed monthly salary of $6,000. This is based on your salary, and not based on your combined household income.

fact_text: The Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) is for a common-law spouse, step-child or handicapped child of an Employment Pass or S Pass holder. Pass holders earning over SGD 12,000 can also get a pass for parents.
evidence_quote: The Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) is for a common-law spouse, step-child or handicapped child of an Employment Pass or S Pass holder. Pass holders earning over $12,000 can also get a pass for parents.
